Tonight at 9pm GMT (yes, GMT, the clocks went back while you slept) I'm DJing live from a secret studio in Burntwood, with the stream open from about 8:30 for a warm-up. It runs on my own Owncast server, so the chat is open to anyone with no login, and you can follow it from your Fediverse account at @aardvark@live.theaardvark.co.uk.
